column1: # BH-5797) calls an allow-list entry or a lint-silencing marker. One rule a line,
# tab-separated: id, route, path ERE, hunk ERE, added-line ERE, reason.
# route human = a public-leak allow-list: the PR is labelled needs-human and no
# lead review is asked until a person clears it. route lead = the line goes into
# the lead review request notes for the Opus lead to judge, and a lead marker
# (a rule with a line ERE) must carry its reason on the same line
# (bin/marker-reason-lint.sh, in the rules pack). "-" matches anything; a path ERE
# that starts with "!" must NOT match. The hunk ERE is read against the hunk
# header (the enclosing definition). Each marker is written with one bracketed
# letter so this file is no hit for its own rules.
